name: Dumbbell Bench Press
common_faults: excessive ROM causing shoulder anterior capsule stretch

substitutions.note: barbell version; greater load ceiling, less shoulder-friendly ROM
incline angle shifts load to upper pec and anterior delt

contraindications: shoulder impingement provoked by horizontal pressing with dumbbells
resistance_profile: hardest off the chest; easier toward lockout; wider ROM than barbell version

provenance.notes: Greater ROM than barbell and independent arm movement allows shoulder-friendlier mechanics. SFR heuristic.
